## Exercise - Reading UK public health monitoring data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
influenza_data <- read_csv("data/influenza_data.csv")
gt(head(influenza_data))
```

## Exercise - Plotting public health data
```{r}
ggplot(influenza_data, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Weekly positivity") +
  ggtitle("Weekly Positivity of people taking a PCR test for Influenza")
```
